race.comment: JUST PRECIOUS (15) made the perfect return at Doomben when arriving just in time to get the bob, with the second horse subsequently winning. Is sure to have come on from that and should prove tough to stave off again under the featherweight. GRAM (5) is absolutely airborne and continues to be expertly placed by the Gollan camp. Sets up another treat for him and there's no reason he can't win again. Stablemate TEN DEEP (8) brings fresh blood and arrives off two stylish trial wins. SER JOH (7) folded up last time here when well supported but his prior form is up to the mark. A month in between could get him back on track.
